role: Adds or removes a player name from the client's tab player list (GuiPlayerInfo), with the ping.
scope_reason: The only consumer is the tab player list GUI, which the native client does not render; the replay runs one player.

members.name: S38PacketPlayerListItem
members.note: the decoder's ctor only: Packet.generatePacket instantiates it by reflection (newInstance) for bytes read off a socket (MessageDeserializer); the integrated server's local channel passes packet objects with no codec (NetworkManager.provideLocalClient adds only the packet_handler), so it never runs

notes: Sent at login, on logout and in the 20 tick ping rotation (ServerConfigurationManager.java:295, 335, 583); the native engine never builds it.
